  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,600&amp;family=Overpass:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;family=Red+Hat+Mono:wght@500&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

</head>
<body class="bg-light-surface text-light-on-surface antialiased">
  <div class="min-h-[1024px] flex flex-col" data-stitch-vh="min-h-[1024px]===min-h-screen">

    <!-- Header -->
    <header class="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-light-surface border-b border-light-outline-variant/40">
      <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-gutter-md sm:px-gutter-lg lg:px-page-margin h-16 flex items-center justify-between gap-gutter-md">
        <!-- Brand -->
        <a href="#top" class="flex items-center gap-gutter-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-light-primary rounded-sm">
          <span class="font-headline text-headline-sm text-light-primary tracking-tight" data-design-text-token="headline-sm">Cacao Atelier</span>
        </a>

        <!-- Primary Navigation -->
        <nav aria-label="Điều hướng chính" class="hidden md:flex items-center gap-gutter-xl">
          <a href="#top" class="font-label text-label-lg text-light-primary border-b-2 border-light-primary py-1" data-design-text-token="label-lg">Trang chủ</a>
          <a href="#categories" class="font-label text-label-lg text-light-on-surface-variant hover:text-light-primary transition-colors duration-state-change py-1" data-design-text-token="label-lg">Danh mục</a>
          <a href="#bestsellers" class="font-label text-label-lg text-light-on-surface-variant hover:text-light-primary transition-colors duration-state-change py-1" data-design-text-token="label-lg">Bán chạy</a>
          <a href="#story" class="font-label text-label-lg text-light-on-surface-variant hover:text-light-primary transition-colors duration-state-change py-1" data-design-text-token="label-lg">Về chúng tôi</a>
        </nav>

        <!-- Utility Actions -->
        <div class="flex items-center gap-gutter-xs">
          <!-- COMPONENT: button-icon -->
          <button data-component-id="button-icon" data-component-type="button" data-component-variant="icon" type="button" aria-label="Tìm kiếm sản phẩm" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full text-light-on-surface bg-transparent transition-colors duration-state-change ease-state-change hover:bg-light-surface-container focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-light-primary active:scale-95">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]" aria-hidden="true">search</span>
          </button>

          <div class="relative">
            <!-- COMPONENT: button-icon -->
            <button id="cart-button" data-component-id="button-icon" data-component-type="button" data-component-variant="icon" type="button" aria-label="Mở giỏ hàng" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 rounded-full text-light-on-surface bg-transparent transition-colors duration-state-change ease-state-change hover:bg-light-surface-container focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-light-primary active:scale-95">
              <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]" aria-hidden="true">shopping_bag</span>
            </button>
            <!-- COMPONENT: badge-numeric -->
            <span id="cart-badge" data-component-id="badge-numeric" data-component-type="badge" data-component-variant="numeric" role="status" aria-hidden="true" class="absolute top-1 right-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-4 h-4 px-1 rounded-full bg-light-primary text-light-on-primary pointer-events-none">
              <span id="cart-count" data-design-text-token="label-sm" class="font-label text-label-sm leading-none tabular-nums">2</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main id="top" class="flex-1">

      <!-- Banner chính (Full-bleed Atmospheric Hero) -->
      <section aria-label="Banner chính" class="relative w-full min-h-[480px] md:min-h-[540px] lg:min-h-[580px] flex items-end overflow-hidden bg-light-primary">
        <img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida/ALJJyrCaZr2k7EZmWqG-I9Swr2cf2f5IkczmTQFQgrytK5sWq7tdGPIbbSw2V-cuh1Ax80qf8B-5bgRrJ0Uj93FobO2UfCMWxUtJPIJF9RqBSJmgeANdEEf1Hjh11JLCYTYGUJLjoxWZB0HVh02wqLJwI0d5JU-TOVvFvxGt136omQo_l-oi9Tg0gXMmMaA5TcYPDc9ConX-ed9glgsPwoZCvqUHwyFmJzzOuX-t99AkaarCMMdMegkAR0bfuw56DNlS" alt="Kẹo socola thủ công từ hạt cacao nguyên chất trên nền gỗ tối giản" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover object-center">
        <!-- Warm dark scrim for crisp contrast on bottom-left copy -->
        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-tr from-light-primary/95 via-light-primary/70 to-transparent"></div>

        <div class="relative z-10 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-gutter-md sm:px-gutter-lg lg:px-page-margin py-gutter-xl md:py-section">

            <span data-component-id="typography-label" data-component-type="typography" data-component-variant="label" data-design-text-token="label-md" class="font-label text-label-md text-light-on-primary tracking-wide">Mẻ rang mới · Đắk Lắk &amp; Bến Tre</span>

            <!-- COMPONENT: typography-display -->
            <h1 data-component-id="typography-display" data-component-type="typography" data-component-variant="display" data-design-text-token="display-lg" class="font-display text-display-lg-mobile md:text-display-lg text-light-on-primary text-balance">Nghệ thuật socola thủ công từ hạt cacao Việt</h1>

            <!-- COMPONENT: typography-body -->
            <p data-component-id="typography-body" data-component-type="typography" data-component-variant="body" data-design-text-token="body-lg" class="font-body text-body-lg text-light-on-primary/95 max-w-prose text-pretty">Tinh tuyển từng hạt cacao lên men tự nhiên, chế tác ít đường để giữ trọn hậu vị sâu lắng và thanh tao.</p>

            <div class="pt-gutter-sm flex flex-wrap items-center gap-gutter-md">
              <!-- COMPONENT: button-primary -->
              <a href="#bestsellers" data-component-id="button-primary" data-component-type="button" data-component-variant="primary" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-gutter-sm px-6 py-3 rounded-DEFAULT bg-light-surface-container-lowest text-light-primary font-label text-label-lg transition-colors duration-state-change ease-state-change hover:bg-light-secondary-container focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-light-on-primary active:scale-[0.98]">
                <span data-design-text-token="label-lg">Khám phá bộ sưu tập</span>
                <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]" aria-hidden="true">arrow_forward</span>
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Danh mục nổi bật (4-column Compact Category Cards) -->
      <section id="categories" aria-labelledby="categories-heading" class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-gutter-md sm:px-gutter-lg lg:px-page-margin py-gutter-xl md:py-section">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-gutter-md mb-gutter-xl">
          <div>

            <p class="font-body text-body-md text-light-on-surface-variant mt-gutter-xs" data-design-text-token="body-md">Chọn hương vị phù hợp cho từng khoảnh khắc thưởng thức.</p>
          </div>
          <a href="#bestsellers" class="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-gutter-xs font-label text-label-lg text-light-primary hover:text-light-tertiary transition-colors duration-state-change" data-design-text-token="label-lg">
            <span>Xem tất cả</span>
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]" aria-hidden="true">chevron_right</span>
          </a>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-gutter-lg items-stretch">

            </div>
            <header class="px-gutter-md pt-gutter-md pb-gutter-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-gutter-sm">

  <script>
    let cartItems = 2;
    function addToCart(btn) {
      cartItems += 1;
      const countEl = document.getElementById('cart-count');
      if (countEl) {
        countEl.textContent = String(cartItems);
      }
      const labelSpan = btn.querySelector('span[data-design-text-token]');
      if (!labelSpan) return;
      const original = labelSpan.textContent;
      labelSpan.textContent = 'Đã thêm';
      btn.classList.add('bg-light-primary', 'text-light-on-primary');
      btn.classList.remove('bg-light-surface-container', 'text-light-on-surface');
      setTimeout(() => {
        labelSpan.textContent = original;
        btn.classList.remove('bg-light-primary', 'text-light-on-primary');
        btn.classList.add('bg-light-surface-container', 'text-light-on-surface');
      }, 1200);
    }
  </script>

                <p class="font-mono text-mono-md text-light-primary tabular-nums" data-design-text-token="mono-md">290.000₫</p>
              </div>
            </article>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

    </main>

    <!-- Minimalist Footer (Shell parity with Homepage) -->
    <footer id="story" class="border-t border-light-outline-variant/40 bg-light-surface">
      <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-gutter-md sm:px-gutter-lg lg:px-page-margin py-gutter-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-gutter-md">
        <div>
          <p class="font-headline text-headline-sm text-light-primary" data-design-text-token="headline-sm">Cacao Atelier</p>
          <p class="font-body text-body-sm text-light-on-surface-variant mt-1" data-design-text-token="body-sm">Socola thủ công từ hạt cacao Việt · Giao hàng lạnh trong 2 giờ tại TP.HCM &amp; Hà Nội</p>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-gutter-lg">
          <a href="../homepage/CacaoAtelierHome.html#categories" class="font-label text-label-md text-light-on-surface-variant hover:text-light-primary transition-colors duration-state-change" data-design-text-token="label-md">Chính sách bảo quản</a>
          <a href="../homepage/CacaoAtelierHome.html#bestsellers" class="font-label text-label-md text-light-on-surface-variant hover:text-light-primary transition-colors duration-state-change" data-design-text-token="label-md">Đặt quà doanh nghiệp</a>
          <span class="font-body text-body-sm text-light-on-surface-variant" data-design-text-token="body-sm">© 2026 Cacao Atelier</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>

  </div>

  <script>
    let cartItems = 2;
    let qty = 1;

    function selectGalleryImage(btn, src, alt) {
      const mainImg = document.getElementById('main-product-image');
      if (mainImg) {
        mainImg.src = src;
        mainImg.alt = alt;
      }
      document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-thumb').forEach((el) => {
        el.classList.remove('border-2', 'border-light-primary');
        el.classList.add('border', 'border-light-outline-variant/60');
      });
      btn.classList.remove('border', 'border-light-outline-variant/60');
      btn.classList.add('border-2', 'border-light-primary');
    }

    function selectVariant(btn, priceText) {
      const priceEl = document.getElementById('product-price');
      if (priceEl) {
        priceEl.textContent = priceText;
      }
      document.querySelectorAll('.variant-btn').forEach((el) => {
        el.classList.remove('border-2', 'border-light-primary');
        el.classList.add('border', 'border-light-outline-variant');
      });
      btn.classList.remove('border', 'border-light-outline-variant');
      btn.classList.add('border-2', 'border-light-primary');
    }

    function updateQty(delta) {
      qty = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, qty + delta));
      const qtyEl = document.getElementById('qty-value');
      if (qtyEl) {
        qtyEl.textContent = String(qty);
      }
    }

    function addDetailToCart() {
      cartItems += qty;
      const countEl = document.getElementById('cart-count');
      if (countEl) {
        countEl.textContent = String(cartItems);
      }
      const labelEl = document.getElementById('add-detail-label');
      if (!labelEl) return;
      const original = labelEl.textContent;
      labelEl.textContent = 'Đã thêm vào giỏ';
      setTimeout(() => {
        labelEl.textContent = original;
      }, 1200);
    }
  </script>


</body></html>

          <a href="../homepage/CacaoAtelierHome.html#bestsellers" class="font-label text-label-md text-light-on-surface-variant hover:text-light-primary transition-colors duration-state-change" data-design-text-token="label-md">Đặt quà doanh nghiệp</a>

  <script>
    let cartItems = 2;

    function addToCart(btn) {
      cartItems += 1;
      const countEl = document.getElementById('cart-count');
      if (countEl) {
        countEl.textContent = String(cartItems);
      }
      const labelSpan = btn.querySelector('span[data-design-text-token]');
      if (!labelSpan) return;
      const original = labelSpan.textContent;
      labelSpan.textContent = 'Đã thêm';
      btn.classList.add('bg-light-primary', 'text-light-on-primary');
      btn.classList.remove('bg-light-surface-container', 'text-light-on-surface');
      setTimeout(() => {
        labelSpan.textContent = original;
        btn.classList.remove('bg-light-primary', 'text-light-on-primary');
        btn.classList.add('bg-light-surface-container', 'text-light-on-surface');
      }, 1200);
    }

    function filterCategory(btn, category) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach((chip) => {
        chip.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
        chip.classList.remove('bg-light-primary', 'text-light-on-primary');
        chip.classList.add('bg-light-surface-container-low', 'text-light-on-surface-variant', 'border', 'border-light-outline-variant/60');
      });
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      btn.classList.remove('bg-light-surface-container-low', 'text-light-on-surface-variant', 'border', 'border-light-outline-variant/60');
      btn.classList.add('bg-light-primary', 'text-light-on-primary');

      let visible = 0;
      document.querySelectorAll('.product-card').forEach((card) => {
        const match = category === 'all' || card.dataset.category === category;
        card.classList.toggle('hidden', !match);
        if (match) visible += 1;
      });
      const countLabel = document.getElementById('visible-count');
      if (countLabel) {
        countLabel.textContent = 'Hiển thị ' + visible + ' sản phẩm';
      }
    }

    function sortProducts(mode) {
      const grid = document.getElementById('product-grid');
      if (!grid) return;
      const cards = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.product-card'));
      cards.sort((a, b) => {
        if (mode === 'price-asc') return Number(a.dataset.price) - Number(b.dataset.price);
        if (mode === 'price-desc') return Number(b.dataset.price) - Number(a.dataset.price);
        return Number(a.dataset.order) - Number(b.dataset.order);
      });
      cards.forEach((card) => grid.appendChild(card));
    }
  </script>
